blocks.html: Reality show winner and teen heartthrob Bailey May is set to melt the hearts of many Kapampangans as he serenades them with his sweet love songs on May 15 at Robinsons Starmills Pampanga Activity Area (Level 1), 5 PM. Fans can even get up close and personal with him by joining the Meet and Greet session after the show. Prepare to fall in love with his good looks and musicality as he sings songs from his self-titled album- Gusto Kita, Can You Be My Girl, Boom Goes My Heart, Build Me up, Buttercup, Gotta WiN and Now We're Together. His successful album produced by Ms. Jaimie Rivera and launched last year under Star Music, caught the hearts of many and immediately earned its popularity among Filipino romantics. The thirteen-year-old Fil-Brit celebrity became popularly known for his videos in YouTube showing him do amazing covers of pop music icons even prior to joining a Filipino reality show in 2015. Now, he is considered to be one of the most preferred artists and influencers with over 790,000 followers in Facebook, 524,000 followers in Instagram, 200,000 followers in twitter, and 8,000 subscribers in YouTube.
